name: Flip Book
description: A framework-free Web Component that stacks pages into a book: every leaf carries two of them, a turn follows the hand round the spine, and the arrows either side do the same thing a leaf at a time.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Eight pages on four leaves, turned by hand, by the arrows, or from the keyboard.

variants.name: Content
variants.description: Pages made of words and a working link, and an odd page count that ends on a blank.

variants.name: Drag
variants.description: How far and how fast commits a turn, what falls back, and what no-drag takes away.

variants.name: Pace
variants.description: A twelve-page stack with a visible thickness, and turns from a fifth of a second to over one.

variants.name: States
variants.description: One page, two pages, a page that never arrived, and reduced motion.
